frontmatter.name: note-organizer
frontmatter.title: Note Organizer — raw notes to coherent structure
frontmatter.description: Organize existing messy notes into faithful atomic notes, an actionability sort or one coherent document; reconcile every input item and preserve conflicts. TRIGGER: "organize these notes", "sort my meeting notes", "make sense of this brain dump", "dedupe my capture inbox". SKIP: explicit llms output → notes-to-llms-txt; live capture or external extraction → content- ingestion-extraction; new prose → writing-expert; choose a PKM system → research-methodology (references/research-note-taking-pkm.md); one-document fact inventory → llms-txt-tooling (references/document-distiller.md); saving a memory entry without reorganizing notes belongs to the host memory workflow.
whenToUse: organize, clean up, or declutter this pile of messy notes
sort my meeting / standup notes into actions, problems, decisions, and wins
turn my scattered reading notes into linked atomic notes with an index (MOC)
make sense of my capture inbox / brain dump — what's actionable?
dedupe and restructure these notes without losing anything
